items.title: Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS): A Shared Specification for  AI Agents to Safely Operate Physical Devices
items.summary: Anthropic has opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared driver specification that lets AI agents discover and safely operate physical devices. Instrument integration that normally takes weeks or months drops to hours: Carnegie Mellon went from raw equipment to a finished dose-response curve in eight, and QuEra's laser relock improved from 58% to 99.3% across 700 trials. MHS is model-agnostic, reachable over MCP, and enforces safety limits in the driver rather than the prompt. The post Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS): A Shared Specification for AI Agents to Safely Operate Physical Devices appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了模型硬體標準 (MHS) 的研究預覽版。 MHS 是一種共享驅動程式規範，可讓 AI 代理程式發現並安全地操作實體設備。通常需要數週甚至數月才能完成的儀器集成，現在只需數小時即可完成：卡內基梅隆大學僅用了八分鐘就完成了從原始設備到最終劑量反應曲線的繪製；QuEra 的激光重鎖定成功率在 700 次試驗中從 58% 提升至 99.3%。 MHS 與模型無關，可透過 MCP 協定訪問，並在驅動程式而非提示訊息中強制執行安全限制。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Anthropic 發布了模型硬體標準 (MHS) 的研究預覽版：一種用於 AI 代理安全操作實體設備的共享規範」。

items.title: Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance
items.summary: Google Research has introduced WikiSkill, a framework that gives AI agents a persistent knowledge base. Instead of discarding what they learned after each run, agents document both failures and successes in a wiki-like structure and use that knowledge to get better over time. Larger models benefit more, but smaller models with WikiSkill can match the performance of larger ones without it. The article Google's WikiSkill gives AI agents a persistent memory of past mistakes to sharpen future performance appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google Research 推出了 WikiSkill，這是一個為 AI 智能體提供持久知識庫的框架。智能體不會在每次運行後丟棄學習到的知識，而是將成功和失敗都記錄在類似維基百科的結構中，並利用這些知識不斷改進。大型模型受益更多，但即使使用 WikiSkill，小型模型也能達到未使用該框架的大型模型的性能水平。文章《Google's WikiSkill 為 AI 智能體提供對過去錯誤的持久記憶，以提升未來表現》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research
items.summary: LAION's Big Video Dataset (BVD) is one of the largest open video datasets for AI research, with 80 million videos, 10 million hours of runtime, and 55 million auto-described clips. Models trained on BVD beat the previous benchmark, InternVid, by up to 2.1 percentage points. Legally, LAION can likely point to a 2024 Hamburg court ruling that allows collecting copyrighted content for non-commercial research. The article LAION drops massive open video dataset with 10 million hours of footage for AI research appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: LAION 的大型視訊資料集 (BVD) 是目前最大的開放視訊資料集之一，用於人工智慧研究，包含 8000 萬個影片、1000 萬小時的運行時間和 5500 萬個自動描述的片段。在 BVD 上訓練的模型比先前的基準資料集 InternVid 的效能高出 2.1 個百分點。在法律方面，LAION 可以援引 2024 年漢堡法院的一項裁決，該裁決允許出於非商業研究目的收集受版權保護的內容。本文《LAION 發布包含 1000 萬小時影片素材的大型開放視訊資料集用於人工智慧研究》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_ai.title: Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS): A Shared Specification for  AI Agents to Safely Operate Physical Devices
items_ai.summary: Anthropic has opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared driver specification that lets AI agents discover and safely operate physical devices. Instrument integration that normally takes weeks or months drops to hours: Carnegie Mellon went from raw equipment to a finished dose-response curve in eight, and QuEra's laser relock improved from 58% to 99.3% across 700 trials. MHS is model-agnostic, reachable over MCP, and enforces safety limits in the driver rather than the prompt. The post Anthropic Opens a Research Preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS): A Shared Specification for AI Agents to Safely Operate Physical Devices appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了模型硬體標準 (MHS) 的研究預覽版。 MHS 是一種共享驅動程式規範，可讓 AI 代理程式發現並安全地操作實體設備。通常需要數週甚至數月才能完成的儀器集成，現在只需數小時即可完成：卡內基梅隆大學僅用了八分鐘就完成了從原始設備到最終劑量反應曲線的繪製；QuEra 的激光重鎖定成功率在 700 次試驗中從 58% 提升至 99.3%。 MHS 與模型無關，可透過 MCP 協定訪問，並在驅動程式而非提示訊息中強制執行安全限制。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Anthropic 發布了模型硬體標準 (MHS) 的研究預覽版：一種用於 AI 代理安全操作實體設備的共享規範」。
